name: U.S. Bank Business Essentials™ Visa® Card

welcome_offer.description: Earn $500 cash back (50,000 bonus points) after eligible net purchases totaling $5,000 or more within 150 days of account opening.
notes: Official U.S. Bank page confirmed $500 after $5,000 in 150 days on 2026-10-19 (150 days stored as ~5 months).

earning_rates.category: Prepaid hotels and car rentals through Travel Center
earning_rates.notes: 6% cash back on prepaid hotels and car rentals booked directly in the U.S. Bank Travel Center.

Unlimited 2% cash back on eligible net purchases; 2.5% total on the first $10,000 in eligible net purchases each month with a qualifying balance ($10,000+) in a qualifying U.S. Bank business checking account (Business Essentials Earning Bonus).

other_benefits.name: 0% intro APR
other_benefits.description: 0% promotional APR on qualifying purchases for the first 12 billing cycles, then 16.99%–27.99% variable APR.

sources.notes: Official U.S. Bank product page (2026-10-19): $0 annual fee, unlimited 2% cash back, 2.5% with qualifying business checking balances, 6% Travel Center, $500 after $5,000 in 150 days.
Official U.S. Bank terms (accurate as of 10/2026): Annual Membership Fee None; Foreign Transaction 3% of each foreign transaction; purchase APR 0% for 12 billing cycles then 16.99%–27.99%.

notes: Flat-rate no-annual-fee U.S. Bank business card. Replaces the retired U.S. Bank Altitude Go Business listing (old id us-bank-altitude-go-biz redirects here). 3% foreign transaction fee.
